peopleAlsoAsk.question: Is steel wool a metal or nonmetal?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Steel wool comes in a variety of grades based on the coarseness of the metal, from extra fine to very course. The coarser the metal, the more abrasive it is; the finer it is, the less harsh it will be. The metal wires are bundled together in cluster, which are then amassed together in a large sheet.
